note: Vendored scanner data. Same ruling as ../../deck/data/_provenance.json and 003_catalog.sql line 34: the file is the authority, the DB column is a seed nobody trusts, and a scraper only ever proposes a diff for human review. Here the reason is sharper than usual — 'the physical card prints this code' is a fact about an object, so no upstream field can ever assert it and the only possible authority is a human who looked at a card.

printed-set-code.json.derived_from: roadmap/plans/card-scanner-redesign/p2-work/ocr/CROSSWALK.md §2.5, which built the table from TCGdex Set.abbreviation.official (GET /v2/en/sets/:id, fetched live 2026-09-05) restricted to the sets whose cards actually print a code.
printed-set-code.json.authority: THIS FILE. card_set.abbreviation (migration 048) is an upstream mirror the weekly catalog sync overwrites wholesale, and card_set.prints_set_code is a seeded convenience column that does not self-maintain. apps/api/src/scan/printedSetCode.ts cross-checks the two at dev startup and logs divergence; it never lets the DB win.
printed-set-code.json.not_the_same_as_ptcgl: ptcgl-set-alias.json is a DIFFERENT NAMESPACE and the two must never be merged. The card says SVP and MEP; the deck list says PR-SV and PR-ME. Crown Zenith's Galarian Gallery is CRZ:GG printed and CRZ-GG in a deck list. API.md describes the deck exporter's `setCode` as 'the expansion code PRINTED on the card', which is true for the SV/ME sets and over-claims for every pre-2023 set that table also answers for (CROSSWALK §2.2, §8.3).
printed-set-code.json.printed_era_only: 29 rows, because only 29 sets print a code. English Pokémon cards began printing one with Scarlet & Violet on 2023-03-31; the other 189 sets carry a set SYMBOL graphic, which is an image-classification problem and explicitly out of scope for the OCR pass (CROSSWALK §7.4).
printed-set-code.json.confidence: HIGH for the 26 rows flagged verified:true — the SV/ME strips were read directly off real scans (sv01-005, sv01-245, sv03-125, sv04.5-091, me05-039, svp-001, svp-500, mep-001, mee-001, sve-017). LOW for the three flagged verified:false (2023sv/MCD23, 2024sv/MCD24, mfb/MFB): no art exists upstream and our CDN serves placeholders, so whether those cards print a code at all is unknown. See the file's own _mcd_mfb_caveat.
printed-set-code.json.cross_check_source: pokemontcg.io set.ptcgoCode is an approved source in this repo (research/CARD-ART-SOURCES.md §9) and a reasonable third opinion, but it is NOT blendable: it is the PTCGL namespace for promos (PR-SV vs SVP), it reuses a parent code for sub-sets so it has 8 collisions where TCGdex has 0, and TR/TRR point at opposite sets in the two feeds (CROSSWALK §6.2). Propose a diff; adopt nothing automatically.
printed-set-code.json.todo: Grows by roughly four rows a year. A new SV/ME-era set needs: a row here, and the set id added to 048's prints_set_code seed list if any SQL-side filter has come to depend on that column. The dev-startup cross-check names the missing set by id.

art-families.json.derived_from: scripts/scan-bench/art_families.py over scripts/scan-bench/same_art.py's output: every same-name printing pair compared by ORB features on CLAHE-equalised luma under one near-identity RANSAC homography (colour-blind, crop-blind), joined when >= 80 inliers fall in the art band (rows 10-55%) with corner shift <= 0.15 of the width, or when the 9x8 dHash is within 6 bits, or (the foil pass, added 2026-10-10 for holo vs non-holo printings) when the frame lines up (>= 150 inliers, shift <= 0.05) and, with B laid over A by that homography, one contiguous shared figure covers >= 0.24 of the inner art window, the frame colours agree (a*/b* NCC >= 0.6 outside the art) and the figure's colours correlate (>= 0.3), Energy cards excepted; transitive closure. Catalogue art from the card-art bucket (the scan bench's mirror), 2026-10-10; a dHash join is vetoed where the image comparison measured different pictures (art inliers < 10 and no shared figure; Energy exempt).
art-families.json.authority: THIS FILE, regenerated from the catalogue art. Nothing in the database mirrors it. A card absent from it is treated as having no same-art printing, which is the scanner's behaviour before the file existed.
art-families.json.known_gaps: Holo/non-holo pairs whose shared figure is small or flat still fall below the foil pass's 0.24 bar: of the 31 Jungle/Fossil #1-16 vs #17-32 pairs, 26 are joined (9 by the ORB/dHash rules, 17 by the foil pass) and 5 are not (Jungle Electrode, Vaporeon, Wigglytuff; Fossil Gengar, Raichu) — redrawn pictures of the same Pokemon also score up to 0.21, so the bar cannot go lower on this measure. Basic Energy cards are left to the ORB rule. Rainbow, gold and shiny recolours of a full art are kept OUT by the foil pass's colour gates, but the ORB rule already joins some of them (e.g. sv08-219/sv08-247 gold, sm9-163/sm9-185 rainbow) because it is colour-blind by design. Cards with no catalogue art (Celebrations Classic Collection, some promos) cannot be compared at all.
